title: Practical Vim
blurb: Learn Vim as a small language of operators, motions and text objects: the dot command, modes, files, registers and macros, patterns and substitution, project tools, a real-world setup and a 14-day practice plan. Turn on Vim mode in the ⚙ settings menu and practise in every editor on this site.
sources: Drew Neil, Practical Vim, 2nd edition (Pragmatic Bookshelf)
